MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels like a useful next addition to my 720p TV and DVD player because it would add streaming to equipment I already use.",
    "Storage is connected to my repeated memory-card and camera-accessory purchases, although that connection alone does not make a 16TB drive useful to me now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 4K streaming stick emphasizes display capabilities my 720p TV cannot take advantage of, while the HD option fits my stated use.",
    "The Echo speakers and displays introduce voice-assistant and calling uses I have not been seeking; my tablet and car accessories served specific screen, mounting, and connection needs.",
    "Neither pair of earbuds addresses a current need shown by my purchases, and my old Apple charging cable does not establish that AirPods would fit my current equipment.",
    "A 16TB drive is a much larger storage commitment than my memory-card purchases suggest I need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a whole range of Amazon and Alexa devices.",
    "My purchases of electronics accessories seem to have been treated as a broad desire for more electronic devices, regardless of what task they help me complete.",
    "My GPS accessories and older Apple cable seem to have been stretched into interest in car voice assistants and wireless earbuds."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose practical accessories that support existing equipment, such as mounts, cables, card readers, cases, and power strips.",
    "Specific compatibility matters to me: the right connector, memory-card format, lens-cap size, or TV capability makes an accessory useful.",
    "My recurring camera and memory-card purchases provide stronger reasons for relevant accessories than for smart speakers or calling displays.",
    "My storage purchases support considering storage accessories, but they do not establish a need for very large capacity."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics, but mostly missed my preference for practical additions that fit the equipment and tasks already evident in my purchases."
}
